pr.body:
## Verified mismatch
Deployed platform Session route reads `FARM_V2_BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET` and `x-farm-v2-shared-secret`; deployed Farm API revision uses `REPLIT_APP_SHARED_SECRET` and `x-replit-shared-secret`.

## Changes
- Preserve legacy Replit secret/header for authorization and Preview Session behavior.
- When explicitly configured, use separate `FARM_V2_BRIDGE_SHARED_SECRET` and `x-farm-v2-shared-secret` **only** for Session exchange/revoke.
- Add three regression tests covering Preview, bridge mode, and missing secrets.

## NOT YET VERIFIED
Tests have not been executed; no isolated integration or real login verified. The platform production secret is not configured in visible Vercel environment variables, and no secret was created/copied. Do not merge or deploy until platform route and secret provisioning are validated. No live DB, OAuth or production deployment changed.
